tier_should.rationale: Compelling, scalable measurement of research pivots across papers and patents; documents pervasive, increasing pivot penalty; uses within-author analysis and exogenous shocks; challenges outsider-advantage narrative; strong data and broad implications suit top general/field journals despite observational limits.

tier_will.rationale: Despite breadth and timely COVID case, causal identification and measurement choices may concern top general outlets; likely to land in top field journals in innovation/management or PNAS/Science Advances.
